---
name: 📱 New Device / Loader Support Request
about: Request support or loader verification for a specific phone model or chipset
title: '[DEVICE] '
labels: device-support, loader
assignees: ''
---

**Device Specification**
- **Brand**: (e.g. Oppo, Vivo, Tecno, Infinix, Samsung)
- **Model Name / Number**: (e.g. Tecno Camon 20 Pro / CK7n)
- **Processor / Chipset**: (e.g. MediaTek Helio G99 / MT6789)
- **Storage Type**: (e.g. UFS 2.2 / eMMC 5.1)
- **Android Version**: (e.g. Android 13 / HiOS 13)

**Requested Operation**
- [ ] BROM SLA / DAA Auth Bypass
- [ ] Preloader / Firehose Matching
- [ ] Fastboot A/B Partition Switch
- [ ] Security NV / QCN Backup
- [ ] Factory Reset / FRP Recovery

**Loader or Partition Dump Availability**
Do you have an authentic preloader, scatter file, firehose programmer, or pac container for this device?
- [ ] Yes (attach or link)
- [ ] No (requires discovery from database)

**Additional Information**
Any known testpoints, hardware IDs, or specific boot key combinations.
